summary: security lens over assistant-bounded-generation (16 product path(s), f7c9949..302173a, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 0 blocking, 1 non-blocking. The new cancellation path generally reaches Bedrock and prevents a not-yet-started warehouse execution, but it misses clients whose response closed before listener registration. Such abandoned requests can still consume the expensive resources this change is intended to protect.
